description.value: West Coast Wildflowers is a Campbell River retail shop on Vancouver Island offering an eclectic mix of wellness products, botanical soaps, Indigenous-themed goods, clothing, and local food and drink. The store carries Northwest Coast artwork soap bars through its Potlatch Soap line and features a dedicated children's section called Little Wildflowers. It also hosts workshops and events, making it a cultural stop as well as a shop.
